nonliteral_verifications.source:
Infuse your weapon with the power of the Sun, adding %0.1f light damage on each melee hit.
		Additionally, if you have a temporary damage shield active, melee hits will increase its power by %d once per turn.
		The damage dealt and shield bonus will increase with your Spellpower.

86: 	callbackOnMeleeAttack = function(self, t, target, hitted, crit, weapon, damtype, mult, dam)
87: 		if self.turn_procs.weapon_of_light then return end
88: 		if hitted and self:hasEffect(self.EFF_DAMAGE_SHIELD) and (self:reactionToward(target) < 0) then
89: 			self.turn_procs.weapon_of_light = true
90: 			-- Shields can't usually merge, so change the parameters manually
91: 			local shield = self:hasEffect(self.EFF_DAMAGE_SHIELD)
92: 			local shield_power = t.getShieldFlat(self, t)
93: 
94: 			shield.power = shield.power + shield_power
95: 			self.damage_shield_absorb = self.damage_shield_absorb + shield_power
96: 			self.damage_shield_absorb_max = self.damage_shield_absorb_max + shield_power
97: 			shield.dur = math.max(2, shield.dur)
98: 		end
99: 		if hitted and self:isTalentActive(self.T_GRAVITIC_EFFULGENCE) then
100: 			local list = table.values(self:projectCollect({type="ball", radius=5, x=target.x, y=target.y, friendlyfire=false}, target.x, target.y, Map.ACTOR))
101: 			table.sort(list, "dist")
102: 			for _, l in ipairs(list) do
103: 				if l.target:canBe("knockback") then l.target:pull(target.x, target.y, 5) end
104: 			end
105: 			self:project({type="ball", radius=2, x=target.x, y=target.y, friendlyfire=false}, target.x, target.y, DamageType.LIGHT, t.getDamage(self, t))
106: 		end
107: 	end,
108: 	info = function(self, t)
109: 		local damage = t.getDamage(self, t)
110: 		local shieldflat = t.getShieldFlat(self, t)
111: 		return ([[Infuse your weapon with the power of the Sun, adding %0.1f light damage on each melee hit.
112: 		Additionally, if you have a temporary damage shield active, melee hits will increase its power by %d and set its duration to 2 (if not already higher), once per turn.
113: 		The damage dealt and shield bonus will increase with your Spellpower.]]):
114: 		tformat(damDesc(self, DamageType.LIGHT, damage), shieldflat)
